overview_description.description:
Taali is a 'better for you' food company. We have a simple vision, we want our products to be a delicious and guilt-free snack that is loaded with the good stuff.

Our anchor brand Taali Taali is a guilt-free snack made from popped water lily seeds. Our products are made of Non-GMO, whole, and natural ingredients that you can pronounce and spell to create a difference you can taste. We have on average 20% fewer calories and 67% less fat per serving (28g) than the leading popcorn brand. Roasted never tasted this good.

about_short_description.short_description: Taali Foods is a​ food company that offers products made from Non GMO, whole, and natural ingredients.

product.name: Protein Puffs
product.description: Crunchy snacks made by blending and puffing protein-rich ingredients like jowar, chickpeas, lentils, rice, and soy, then slow-roasted and seasoned.

product.name: Roasted Makhana
product.description: Snacks made from water lily seeds that are expanded, popped to snack size, slow-roasted, and seasoned with spices and toppings.

product.name: Roasted Peanuts
product.description: Slow-roasted Bharuchi peanuts seasoned with masala, providing a protein and fiber-rich snack without trans fats or cholesterol.

product.name: Variety Packs
product.description: Combination packs containing assortments of Protein Puffs, Roasted Makhana, and Roasted Peanuts in various quantities.
